responsibility: Implements the Resolver2_0 early name-resolution pass that runs after top-level collection to resolve macro-related names before ordinary expression and type lookup. This file drives the TopLevel prepass, maintains a separate textual macro scope stack for macro_rules! shadowing across blocks and modules, resolves macro invocations either textually or through the macro ForeverStack path resolver, records macro-definition and invocation mappings in Analysis::Mappings, processes attribute and derive procedural macro references, and accumulates unresolved-macro diagnostics for this early phase.
same_name_distinction: Implements Early’s pass logic: running the TopLevel prepass, maintaining the textual macro-scope stack across blocks and modules, resolving macro invocations and attribute/derive macros, and recording mappings and unresolved-macro errors; the paired header only defines the class shape and helper types such as TextualScope.
